summary: Activating a reference value asks the host what to open; the component follows no link and opens no window by itself.

then.note: The host may push another panel, route to a full page, or refuse. Two decisions it must keep: following the href would be the component routing for the consumer, and opening a window itself would be the component deciding whether a half-edited window may be covered. Each window is its own element, so one left mid-edit underneath another keeps its unsaved changes.
